Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for cathodic protection systems 
and infrastructure in the area of influence of any new cathodic protection 
systems, which must be performed on an annual bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
title block.
The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Eman Abd El-Aziz El-Henawy, 
 reviewed by eng Wageh Khalil, 
 accepted by eng Ali Zahran general manager, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control 
 eng. Adel El Naggar, approved by eng Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria 
 Power Station,
This document certified by eng 
 . Samir abd El-Gelil general manager and MPIS coordinator and 
 approved by eng. Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay inspection and quality head 
 sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued the qualified maintenance staff 
 must carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety shoes, 
 helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety shoes, 
 helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Tools 
and Equipment
High input impedance voltmeter
Suitable half-cell (The standard practical half-cells are copper/copper 
 sulphate, silver/silver chloride/seawater, silver/silver chloride/ potassium chloride and zinc).
Tester (ammeter).
Work to be carried out
Galvanic-anode outputs 
monitoring method
Galvanic-anode outputs may be monitored, as can currents 
 in electrical bonds between structures.
Record the results and compare them with the 
 previous data results.
If the result is 
 out of criteria range, we treat the damage or not good parts or replace 
 them.
